Message:
drm/amdgpu: kfd_pre_reset outside req_full_gpu cause sriov hang

XGMI hive put kfd_pre_reset into amdgpu_device_lock_adev,
but outside req_full_gpu of sriov.
It would make sriov hang during reset.
